3056.html:
3056 *kāra⁶ 'ear'. [Connexion with kárṇa- is not clear]
    Wg. kār 'ear' (← Kho. kār), Kt. kōr, Dm. kâᵃr Morgenstierne FestskrBroch 150, NTS xii 173; — Ash. karmuṭäˊ 'ear', Kt. karmútə 'lobe of ear', Gaw. kumtak 'ear' NTS ii 261 (or poss. all three < karṇapattraka-).
    kāra-⁷ m. 'tax' see kara-².
    Addenda: *kāra-⁶: Kho. kār 'ear' certainly not ← Wg. BKhoT 69.

10545.html:
10545 rakṣá 'guarding' MBh., rakṣaka- m. 'watchman' Pañcat. [√rakṣ]

    *rākṣaka-; rakṣapāla-; *aṅgarakṣa-, gōrakṣa-, *pantharakṣaka-, *bāhurakṣa-, vanarakṣaka-.
